normalization.travel: Level duration includes travel. Down10m/min low SP.7; up9m/min target level gas/SP.
normalization.imperial: Exact feet*.3048 canonical metres and10ft stop grid; MSW oracle, not native FSW defaults.
normalization.physical_depth: Integral minimum-stop time makes upstream truncate displayed stop depth; physical hold uses preceding raw ascent endpoint. Reported display remains separate.
